acquirer.name: Invesco Van Kampen Senior Loan Fund

listed_quote.quote: An early withdrawal charge is imposed on repurchases of shares at the following rates:

announcement.quote: The Invesco Funds Board of Trustees has approved a reorganization of Invesco Prime Income Trust into Invesco Van Kampen Senior Loan Fund, pending shareholder approval.

deals.notes: Both funds issue Class IB shares subject to an early withdrawal charge on repurchase and show XPITX/XPRTX symbols; no exchange listing is stated, so judged not listed. The April 14, 2011 meeting failed to reach quorum because of a tabulation error and votes were re-solicited for a September 14, 2011 meeting (seq 5, 6). Completion is not stated in the excerpts. The 2012 DEFA14As (seq 9-13) list Senior Loan Fund among several Van Kampen closed-end fund registrants but the excerpts do not describe a merger.

problems: Outcome of the Prime Income Trust reorganization is not stated in the excerpts. The 2012 filings (seq 7-13) are compact and do not show what proposal is voted on.
